value.rationale: Balanced complete multipartite (Turán) graphs are canonical dense graph families, and KLX was introduced in 2026 as an application-driven DFS congestion parameter. The result gives the first located exact non-boundary multipartite benchmark, identifies an optimal traversal, and isolates a reusable structural fact: in a complete multipartite graph every DFS branch is a terminal fan from one part. This is a motivated structural extension rather than a parameter substitution or isolated numerical computation.
